Hello,

I have been made aware of your message by Andrew Heiss. I have found the same issue, and post a bug report:
https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/issues/867

To pass this problem I created a small function to filter my dataset. When a single identifiant (in my case called iteration) has all his data equal, i make sure there is only one data:
#pre-treatment
#if all data are equal for one iteration, just put 1
for (iteration in unique(temp$iteration))
{
    values <- temp[temp$iteration == iteration,2]
    if (length(unique(values)) == 1 && length(values) > 1)
    {
        val <- unique(values)
        temp <- temp[! temp$iteration == iteration,]
        temp <- rbind(temp,data.frame(iteration = iteration, median = val))
    }
}

Jean-Marc
